title: Speak, Lord, I Am Listening
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
One night while Samuel lay asleep,
A voice called out his name.
He ran to Eli, "Here I am!"
Three times it came the same.

[Chorus]
Be still, my child, and listen close,
The Lord speaks soft and near.
A quiet feeling in your heart
Will tell you He is here.

[Verse 2]
Then Eli said, "It is the Lord!
Next time, say this, my boy:
'Speak, Lord, for I am listening.'"
And Samuel heard with joy.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So close your eyes and quiet down,
The night is soft and deep.
And whisper, "Speak, Lord, I will hear,"
Then drift away to sleep.

[Chorus]
mood: Nighttime music. A delicate, ticking sway moves under the voice, sparse and still, like a dark temple at midnight with only small sounds in the quiet. The first verses hold a hushed wonder, each phrase leaving space, as if the song itself is pausing to listen. By the last verse the sway slows further and sinks low, the pauses growing longer, until the room is quiet enough to hear a whisper.
